answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 151222 Country: India Title: I want to know meaning for name Muhammad Saalif. I heard this is name of one Sahabi. Please confirm. Question: I want to know meaning for name Muhammad Saalif. I heard this is name of one Sahabi. Please confirm. Answer ID: 151222 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 894/931/N=9/1438) Muhammad is the name of the Holy Prophet Muhammad (may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him). Salif means past, previous. However, I could find nowhere in any book that any sahabi was named after the name Salif or Muhammad Salif. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
